premise: Woodpecker knocks on every door to invite everyone to a party; sleepy Owl answers, blinks, and goes straight back to sleep until the evening.
inspiration: The knock-knock rhythm of folk games and the gathering pattern of The Enormous Turnip, turned: the one who can't come is still remembered.
lesson: Good friends remember the ones who can't join in.

en-US.title: Woodpecker Knocks on Doors
en-US.text: {woodpecker:enter} Woodpecker flew in and clung to a tree trunk. {woodpecker:face happy} [excited] He had a wonderful idea: a party! {woodpecker:live} He tapped the bark, {sfx:knock} knock-knock-knock, pressed his eye close to listen… knocked once more, and chirped. Who's there? Along trotted {badger:enter} Badger, busy with breakfast. {badger:live} He sniffed, dug with his front paws — earth flew! — pushed his nose into the hole… and popped up grinning, with earth on his nose. {badger:face happy} A party? I'll bring blackberries! {woodpecker:hop} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Knock, knock, on the next tree, where {owl:enter} Owl sat on his branch. [slowly] Nobody answered. {woodpecker:shake} Knock, knock, KNOCK! {owl:live hold} Owl blinked. He looked around. He yawned… and fell straight back to sleep. [giggles] {woodpecker:face surprised} Oh dear! Owl sleeps in the daytime! [softly] {canvas:confetti 0.4 8s} {woodpecker:face happy} So they had the party very, very quietly, {badger:hearts} and saved the biggest blackberry. {canvas:night 0.6 16s} And when the moon came up, {owl:live resume} Owl opened one eye, then both… {sfx:hoot} hoo-hoo! {owl:face happy} There was his blackberry, waiting.

es-ES.title: Toc, toc: ¡hay fiesta!
es-ES.text: El {woodpecker:enter} pájaro carpintero llegó volando y se agarró a un tronco. {woodpecker:face happy} [excited] Tenía una idea estupenda: ¡una fiesta! {woodpecker:live} Dio golpecitos en la corteza, {sfx:knock} toc-toc-toc, pegó el ojo para escuchar… llamó otra vez, y pió. ¿Quién es? Llegó trotando {badger:enter} Tejón, buscando su desayuno. {badger:live} Olfateó, escarbó con las patas —¡volaba la tierra!—, metió el hocico en el agujero… y salió sonriendo, con tierra en la nariz. {badger:face happy} ¿Una fiesta? ¡Yo llevo moras! {woodpecker:hop} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Toc, toc, en el árbol de al lado, donde {owl:enter} Búho estaba en su rama. [slowly] Nadie contestó. {woodpecker:shake} Toc, toc, ¡TOC! {owl:live hold} Búho parpadeó. Miró a su alrededor. Bostezó… y se volvió a dormir. [giggles] {woodpecker:face surprised} ¡Vaya! ¡Búho duerme de día! [softly] {canvas:confetti 0.4 8s} {woodpecker:face happy} Así que hicieron la fiesta muy, muy bajito, {badger:hearts} y guardaron la mora más grande. {canvas:night 0.6 16s} Y cuando salió la luna, {owl:live resume} Búho abrió un ojo, luego los dos… {sfx:hoot} ¡uh-uh! {owl:face happy} Allí estaba su mora, esperándolo.

knock.prompt: a woodpecker knocking three quick light taps on a hollow tree trunk

hoot.prompt: one soft, friendly, sleepy owl hoot, two gentle notes
